verdict.rationale: Meltano is open-source, self-hostable, and config-as-code (project files can be versioned and moved), and as an ELT tool it writes data into destinations you own (databases, files, warehouses) rather than a proprietary store, which supports data portability by design. However, there is no explicit documentation or feature addressing bulk data export or a guaranteed open-format 'leave' path, and no independent confirmation of portability in practice. Missing for 10: explicit data-export/portability documentation, evidence of format guarantees across all destinations, and independent confirmation of frictionless migration away from Meltano.
